description:
Activate Horn of Ramos by sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Horn of Ramos from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Oracle's Vault's second ability by tapping it, exiling Horn of Ramos from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn without playing its mana cost.
Cast Horn of Ramos from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Horn of Ramos, untapping Oracle's Vault.
Repeat.

uses.name: Oracle's Vault
uses.cardState: with three or more brick counters on it
